connectors.name: 2x4 pin header (upper right)
connectors.orderNote: USB rule + 2xN rule: the USB-C connector is on the left edge below the header, so the bottom end was taken as closest to USB; position 1 = bottom of the outer (right, board-edge) column, alternating outer/inner bottom to top

uncertain: Pin order start is ambiguous: the USB connector is on the left side edge, roughly level with neither end of the vertical header; the bottom end is slightly closer and was used. If the top end were used, the order would reverse (GND/IO17 first).
BAT and SPK connectors are not labeled per pin (only +/- marks); not transcribed.
